description.en: Original waterfall-ledge teaching rock only: one continuous rock volume has a projecting resistant upper lip and a recessed lower soft bed creating real sheltered undercut space. Intentional side presentation cuts and nominal shape, no water mesh, water-flow simulation, exact site/age or loose stacked-block interpretation.
description.zh: 原创瀑布岩阶教学岩体：单一连续岩体，上部抗蚀岩缘突出，下方较软层后退形成真实遮蔽空间。侧面为展示切面、形态尺度属艺术选择，不导出水体、不模拟水流、不指定地点年代，非松散方砖堆。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
